notes: A small card under a purple LogRocket rocket logo reads 'MCP Consents is requesting access to LogRocket', with the client name in the brand purple. An amber-bordered box shows the callback http://localhost:33418/callback and warns the user to approve only if they trust that destination. Cancel and Approve buttons follow. No sign-in form and no permissions are listed, so the user sees what the callback is but not what access is granted.
